text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In the cafeteria, I caught sight of 
Mejiro Palmer chatting and laughing with 
her friends."

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Friend
text_block_list.text:
...That's what Helios said! And I just 
burst out laughing~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? Ah, ohoho! My, that is quite 
charming—

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Friend
text_block_list.text: Huh? What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
N-No, seriously, it's nothing! Maybe I'm 
just tired lately, I feel kind of off, or 
something...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the fatigue from running 
back-to-back races is causing strange side 
effects. We'll need to reconsider your 
future schedule.
